notes:
v2.3.3 Update
- Fixed the Calendar app starting months on Sunday when Calendaria did not return a weekday value. Smartphone Widget now calculates the weekday through Calendaria's API so dates stay aligned with the source calendar.

announcement.title: 📱 Smartphone Widget v2.3.3
announcement.content:
Smartphone Widget v2.3.3 fixes Calendar alignment with Calendaria.

  • When Calendaria does not include a weekday value in its timestamp response, the phone now calculates it through Calendaria's API so dates stay aligned with the source calendar.
